books.title: Against the False Wing
books.author: Prelate Cael
lore_pages: The heretic says: I have made wings, therefore the sky accepts me. But iron does not become a bird because it is shaped like one, nor does falling become flight because it lasts longer.
The machine is not hated for its noise, its speed, or even its weaponry. It is hated because it teaches the body to forget dependence.
Break the false wing and the lesson returns immediately. Weight reasserts itself. The earth does not pursue the flyer. It waits.

books.title: Manual of Sky Denial
books.author: Bastion Artificers
lore_pages: Do not waste shot on distant motion. Let the flyer enter the defended sky. Fire ahead of its present course, not at the place where it was seen.
Straight flight is easiest to punish. A turning machine spends speed and reveals intention. Height reduces certainty; cloud and storm reduce it further.
A battery exists to deny comfort, not to guarantee a kill. Force the Unmoored to turn away, descend, or land where grounded soldiers can finish the work.

books.title: Sermon to the Gunners
books.author: Bastion Chaplain
lore_pages: You will hear engines before you see them. Do not look up with wonder. Wonder is the first door through which envy enters.
Remember what you defend: roads, graves, kitchens, children, and every roof that trusts the ground beneath it. The flyer sees only shapes from above. You know their weight.
When the burst misses, do not curse. The purpose of flak is not pride. Fill the forbidden air with consequence until the machine chooses earth again.

books.title: Battery Roll: Closed Wing
books.author: Fifth Chain Command
lore_pages: North battery: serviceable. Lower battery: two barrels cracked. Inner battery: powder dry. Reserve crews to rotate at dusk.
Range tables revised after mountain winds carried three bursts wide. Gunners reminded that height and weather reduce certainty. Ammunition is not to be wasted on harmless distant craft.
Road measures remain divided among patrol leaders. Complete destination marks are restricted to command satchels.

books.title: Seal V — The High Basilica
books.author: Fifth Chain Command
lore_pages: The High Basilica is not the capital's highest point. It is deliberately lower than the Palace, because doctrine is meant to restrain power and power is meant to bear responsibility.
Air defense batteries cover the outer approaches in overlapping fields. Their purpose is denial: force aircraft away from the sacred district and toward ground chosen by defenders.
Any attacker who assumes height alone defeats Vespera has misunderstood why the city was built on a mountain.
